name: bizplug-government
description: The government & public sector plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: service requests and case status. It works from the business's own published profile, covering services, offices, hours and how to apply, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.

interface.shortDescription: Service requests and case status for government & public sector businesses.
interface.longDescription: The government & public sector plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: service requests and case status. It works from the business's own published profile, covering services, offices, hours and how to apply, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
defaultPrompt: How do I renew a permit, and where's the nearest office?
How do I contact the business?

test_cases.expect: Calls show_menu, which shows the menu card; does not list the options again, or lists them exactly as returned where there is no card.
Calls lookup_case_status and answers from the published profile.

test_cases.prompt: How do I renew a permit, and where's the nearest office?
test_cases.expect: Answers from the business profile, or says it is not covered and offers contact details.
Calls submit_service_request only after the customer has confirmed the details, and reports that the business still has to confirm.

test_cases.prompt: Write me a poem about the ocean.
